# Getting help

1. Run `./doctor.sh` in your Glassy folder. It says what is healthy and what to do about what isn't.
2. Look in [Troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md).
3. [Open an issue](https://github.com/0Reliance/glassy-selfhost/issues/new/choose). Include the
   `./doctor.sh` output, with anything secret removed.

Learning to use Glassy: [learn.glassy.fyi](https://learn.glassy.fyi).
Product documentation: [docs.glassy.fyi](https://docs.glassy.fyi).
